description: Best for shared tanks, simple filtration, and small public-service sites that depend on direct intake.
corridor_template: rural households, shared storage points, and small public-service sites connected to {region}
default_impact_copy: Operators should keep updates focused on untreated intake, shared storage safety, and continuity for essential public-service sites.

signal_rules.impact_copy: Cloudier water can reduce intake quality quickly and overwhelm simple filtration or storage routines.
Rapid water chemistry shifts can make untreated water harder to use safely for direct intake, meal preparation, and clinic use.
Low oxygen or unstable flow can disrupt small intake systems before the wider community sees visible change.
